meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: Claude 会先分析仓库最近 30 条提交,判断消息语言和风格,再把改动按目录与用途拆成多个原子提交;也能用 rebase/squash 改写历史、按 blame、bisect、log -S 查某处改动是何时由谁引入。
howto.when: 只要涉及 git 操作就会接管:当你提到 “commit”、“rebase”、“squash” 等意图,或问某段代码是谁写的、哪个提交引入的,它按请求类型进入对应模式,不会默认当成提交。

say.text: 把这些改动拆成多个原子提交
say.note: 它会先输出提交计划和拆分理由再执行

say.text: 把这个分支的提交 squash 整理一下
say.note: 本地未推送的历史可被重写整理

say.text: 查一下这行代码是谁、什么时候改的
say.note: 进入历史查找模式,定位引入改动的那次提交

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a git expert: it detects your repo's commit style from recent log, splits changes into several atomic commits by directory and concern, rewrites history via rebase/squash, and traces when or by whom a change was introduced.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any git operation: mentions of "commit", "rebase" or "squash", or questions like who wrote this line or which commit introduced it. It picks the matching mode instead of defaulting to commit.

say_en.text: Split these changes into several atomic commits
say_en.note: It prints a commit plan and reasons first

say_en.text: Squash and clean up the commits on this branch
say_en.note: Local, unpushed history can be rewritten

say_en.text: Find who changed this line and when
